title: Pixels Game of Life
description:
A hyper optimized recreation of Conways Game of Life.
Comes with pretty colors.
detailedDescription:
This project is my 3rd recreation of Conways Game of Life. Every time i built it, I made it better then the ones before. In this version, i used GPU based cell rendering and Unity Jobs to calculate the next cell states to minimize cpu usage so a very high simulation speed was possible.
I also added color, trails and bloom with post processing to make it look pretty.

videos.description: This is a demo video showcasing conways game of life with pretty colors leaving trails behind. As the colors change, the world gets bigger and the simulation runs faster.
